notes: A one-page field aid with no method, no measurement description and no citation behind its chart. It is here because it is the only quantitative statement found anywhere on the downwash question - a hovering UH-60 must be well over 160 ft up to keep rotor wash under 30 mph - and because the README lists downwash as something that could invert the whole concept. Nothing in it licenses extrapolation to a 450 m rotor disc; the comparison in notes/suter-2005-rotor-wash.md is ours.
